title: CPI(M) Demands Withdrawal of Proposed NFSA Amendment
summary: The Communist Party of India (Marxist) has demanded the withdrawal of a proposed amendment to the National Food Security Act, accusing the Union government of trying to weaken the law. The CPI(M) claims that the changes would disproportionately affect poor families and undermine the government's commitment to food security. The party's demands come as the government prepares to introduce the amendment in parliament.
summary_points: The Communist Party of India (Marxist) has demanded the withdrawal of a proposed amendment to the National Food Security Act.

The party's demands come as the government prepares to introduce the amendment in parliament.
The CPI(M) accuses the Union government of trying to weaken the law.
The proposed amendment has sparked controversy over its potential impact on food security and poverty alleviation programs.

summary_hi: सीपीआई(एम) ने एक राष्ट्रीय भोजन सुरक्षा अधिनियम (एनएफएसए) की संशोधन मांगी है, जिसमें उन्होंने सरकार को यह कहने का दावा किया है कि यह प्रस्ताव समाज के गरीब परिवारों को अधिक नुकसान पहुंचाएगा और उनके सामाजिक सुरक्षा की वादगी को कम करेगा।
